g.text: Boxes span the frequency and unit power of the values listed in supply_classes.csv (map_value_ids); single values drawn with a small minimum size.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b6a64

g.text: Efficiency: wall to output unless marked. * amplifier, head or tube only (wall-plug lower). Hatched: H1 klystron/gyrotron, context only.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b6a64

g.text: Pulsed supplies (P1) have no carrier frequency and are not shown. Lab prototypes are excluded from the boxes. M3 is drawn just right of M2; both are at 2.45 GHz.
